About Funding Solutions Experts (FSE)
At FSE, we deliver elite capital solutions to high-growth businesses. We operate in a fast-paced, high-stakes environment where excellence is the standard, not the exception. We do not offer a "comfortable" corporate safety net; instead, we provide a launchpad for the top 1% of sales professionals who want absolute control over their financial destiny through a pure meritocracy.
If you are a self-motivated Closer who thrives in a high-volume, performance-driven environment, this is your opportunity to build an empire.
The Mission: Execute. Close. Lead.
High-Volume B2B Engagement: Conduct focused outbound campaigns (Monday – Friday) targeting business owners and C-suite executives.
Pipeline Management: Manage high-ticket financial sales cycles from initial contact to close, maintaining an authoritative and consultative approach.
Accelerated Leadership Path: We are scouting future Team Leaders. Once you consistently hit your benchmarks, you will be given the autonomy to recruit, train, and scale your own regional "Pod." You will earn direct overrides on every transaction your team closes.
Candidate Profile: The Top 1%
Commanding Communication: Your professional business English is flawless, authoritative, and persuasive. You don't just pitch; you influence key decision-makers.
Relentless Execution: You possess an elite work ethic, show up with high energy every single day, and view "No" as a brief detour on the path to a contract.
Performance Mindset: You excel in high-volume outbound dialing environments. You view critical feedback as revenue-generating data and adapt instantly.
Track Record: Proven experience in high-ticket closing, B2B sales, or financial services is highly preferred.
What FSE Offers
Uncapped Commission Structure: There is no ceiling on your income. Your revenue generation directly dictates your lifestyle.
Rapid Career Progression: We promote strictly on results, not seniority. Transition into a leadership role with team overrides within months of proven success.
Global Remote Flexibility: Work from anywhere in the world, provided you have a high-speed internet connection, a quiet workspace, and an elite daily output.
High-Performance Culture: A zero-drama environment focused exclusively on execution, scale, and financial growth.
Are You Ready to Dominate the Market?
If you have the resilience, the drive, and the skill set to close high-ticket financial deals, we want to hear from you.
Apply today to join an elite team of financial sales professionals.

Amazon Web Services is seeking an Electronic Health Record Principal Sales Executive to drive revenue growth by helping healthcare provider customers adopt Epic on AWS and transform their healthcare organizations as part of this initiative.

Do you have a passion for building relationships with hospital system executives and helping them realize the business value of cloud computing and AI in support of patient care? Would you like to help set the strategy for helping provider customers get the most out of their Epic application, data, and patient care functions?

Do you have a track record of delivering strategic wins and exceeding revenue targets by helping provider customers drive compelling business outcomes? Are you energized by partnering with customers to position AWS as the platform of choice for mission-critical clinical, operations and financial healthcare systems?

Would you like to influence AWS's strategy on how we help our customers drive value in the Epic EHR ecosystem?

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is looking for an experienced and motivated sales/business development professional who aligns with our Leadership Principles and possesses a unique balance of healthcare industry expertise, is comfortable with C-suite conversations, and has consultative selling skills.

You will own strategy, key customer win goals, and revenue targets across a portfolio of healthcare provider accounts, driving adoption of AWS services for Epic EHR workloads.
In collaboration with Solutions Architects, healthcare solution, business development, and partner teams, you will identify key customer accounts, develop account strategies, and lead/coach teams to win strategic multi-year deals.

As a trusted advisor to health system executives, you will help organizations build the business case for migrating Epic environments—including production, alternate production, integrated real-time environments (IRE), data and disaster recovery—to AWS.

You will have the opportunity to shape and execute a go-to-market strategy to build mindshare and accelerate AWS adoption within the healthcare provider segment, specifically focused on Epic EHR.

The ideal candidate must be self-motivated with a proven track record of delivering strategic wins and meeting revenue targets while operating at the C-suite level for healthcare providers. The ability to connect technology with measurable business value—including TCO reduction, operational resilience, and clinical outcomes—is critical.

You should also have a demonstrated ability to think strategically about territory planning, competitive positioning, and long-term account growth.
We are looking for someone who is passionate about the following: Our company credo: "Work hard. Have fun. Make history." In this role, you will love what you do, and instinctively know how to make work fun. You will be dynamic and creative, and willing to take on any challenge and make a big impact.

Enjoy working with healthcare provider executives. You will have a passion for understanding hospital system priorities—cost optimization, operational efficiency, clinical innovation—and positioning AWS as the platform that delivers on those priorities for Epic EHR and associated clinical workloads.

Have a strong understanding of enterprise sales cycles in healthcare IT.
The ideal candidate will have past experience selling technology solutions to hospital systems, health system C-suites, and IT leadership. You will enjoy developing deep customer relationships and account strategies, leveraging your healthcare domain knowledge to earn trust at the executive level. You will regularly collaborate with Solutions Architects, Partner teams, and AWS service teams to bring the full power of AWS to bear on customer opportunities.

· Own and exceed annual revenue targets by driving AWS adoption for Epic EHR workloads across a portfolio of healthcare provider accounts
· Coach and mentor sellers on how to develop winning Epic EHR and ecosystem proposals
· Develop and execute account plans that identify migration opportunities, map stakeholder relationships, and define a path from first engagement through close
· Build and maintain a robust pipeline through prospecting, executive networking, industry events, and collaboration with AWS partner and marketing teams
· Lead complex, consultative sales cycles involving multiple stakeholders—translating technical solution value into financial and operational business outcomes for CFOs, CIOs, CTOs, and clinical leadership
· Partner closely with Solutions Architects to ensure proposed solutions meet customer requirements and position AWS competitively against alternative hosting options
· Engage Systems Integrator (SI) partners to support deal progression, including joint selling motions, SOW development, and commercial structuring
· Negotiate and close multi-year commitments, including Enterprise Discount Programs (EDPs), Private Pricing Agreements (PPAs), and migration-linked investment packages
· Serve as the voice of the customer internally—advocating for product enhancements, service improvements, and go-to-market investments that accelerate Epic on AWS adoption
· Build deep, trust-based relationships with senior executives within hospital systems (CEOs, CFOs, CIOs, CTOs, VP Infrastructure) to establish AWS as a long-term strategic partner
· Contribute to the broader AWS Healthcare sales community by sharing best practices, win/loss insights, and reusable deal strategies

Diverse Experiences — AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn't followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don't let it stop you from applying.
Why AWS? Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world's most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that's why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
Inclusive Team Culture — Here at AWS, it's in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.
Mentorship & Career Growth — We're continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth's Best Employer. That's why you'll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
Work/Life Balance — We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there's nothing we can't achieve in the cloud.

Hello, we’re Instrumentl . We’re a mission-driven startup helping the nonprofit sector to drive impact, and we’re well on our way to becoming the #1 most-loved grant discovery and management tool. To help us get there, we’re hiring a remote Sales Development Representative to represent Instrumentl to prospective clients.

About us: Instrumentl is a hyper-growth YC-backed startup with over 4,500 nonprofit clients, from local homeless shelters to larger organizations like the San Diego Zoo and the University of Alaska. We are building the future of fundraising automation, helping nonprofits to discover, track, and manage grants efficiently through our SaaS platform.

Our charts are dramatically up-and-to-the-right 📈 — we’re cash flow positive and growing quickly, with customers who love us (NPS is 65+ and Ellis PMF survey is 60+). Join us on this rocket ship! About the role: In this role, you’ll be helping organizations big and small get access to more resources so they can grow their impact.

Over the past year, we’ve seen great results reaching out to universities and non-profits to let them know about Instrumentl , and now we are growing a dedicated team to scale this effort. We are looking for someone who loves the idea of spending all day on the phone with non-profits and universities.

But, we’re not just looking for a typical sales rep. We are looking for someone who wants to build a sales career and do good at the same time. This role is perfect for a sales professional early on in their career, or someone looking to career switch into sales, that wants to help some of the best organizations in the world.

The Instrumentl team is fully distributed. Get to know us at instrumentl.com/about !

In this role, you should expect to: Research organizations that would be a good fit for Instrumentl Make over 400 dials per week to engage prospects and book demos with the team Track and document account and decision-maker details in our CRM so that we can close Learn how our value proposition applies to different types of organizations, so that you can engage in quality conversation on the phone Spend 10% of your time collaborating with other departments and/or working on experiments that we think have the potential to be a force multiplier An excellent hire will: Book 10+ demos for the team every week through top of funnel outreach (we have people doing more than 10/week today) Win over organizations with fast follow through, strong attention to detail, and palpable customer empathy Communicate insights and blockers from conversations to help inform how to make our pitch better About You: A recent graduate or early in your career Ability to thrive working in a remote sales environment Interested in sales, startups, or customer-facing roles Comfortable talking to new people and building relationships You welcome feedback, champion new ideas, and encourage others to do likewise You’re curious and are constantly ‘getting to the bottom of things’ You don’t mind rolling up your sleeves and doing hard work You have excellent written and verbal communication skills Bonus (not required): Internship or leadership experience Compensation & benefits: OTE $60,000-$75,000 100% covered health, dental, and vision insurance for employees (50% for dependents) Generous PTO policy, including parental leave 401(k) Company laptop + stipend to set up your home workstation Company retreats for in-person time with your colleagues Work with awesome nonprofits around the US.

We partner with incredible organizations doing meaningful work, and you get to help power their success. What to expect: Instrumentl is evolving rapidly. You’ll always have new challenges and opportunities to grow in your role here - you won’t be bored!

You’ll be an early member of our small but mighty team, playing a huge part in shaping our culture for the years and teammates to come. At Instrumentl : - We’re customer-focused. We routinely seek feedback from our customers to improve the Instrumentl experience for everyone.

Our first company value is "The customer is the hero" and we mean it. - We love to experiment. Our team is constantly generating new concepts and iterating to see what works - ideation and experimentation are essential here. "Bend the curve" is another key company value. - We’re approachable and collaborative.

Everyone has a voice, and we’re all building Instrumentl together. - We kick it every day with some of the nicest people in the world. No joke, our customers are often on the front lines educating kids, saving endangered species, and restoring watersheds.

In helping them take advantage of Instrumentl ’s technology, you’re helping them move the world forward. Ready to apply? Using the Apply button below, submit your responses to the following questions: 1. What excites you the most about joining the Instrumentl team? 2. Why are you the ideal candidate for the Instrumentl SDR role? 3.

What is your desired salary range? Along with your answers, please include your resume or CV. At Instrumentl , we pride ourselves on building a diverse team from the ground up. Every role is an opportunity to teach, learn, and create some of your best work - if you’re excited to grow along with us, we encourage you to apply!

As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations. Since 2011, our mission hasn’t changed — we’re here to stop breaches, and we’ve redefined modern security with the world’s most advanced AI-native platform.

Our customers span all industries, and they count on CrowdStrike to keep their businesses running, their communities safe and their lives moving forward. We’re also a mission-driven company. We cultivate a culture that gives every CrowdStriker both the flexibility and autonomy to own their careers.

We’re always looking to add talented CrowdStrikers to the team who have limitless passion, a relentless focus on innovation and a fanatical commitment to our customers, our community and each other. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you.

About the Role: As a Specialist Sales Manager, NG SIEM/Logscale, you will have the exciting opportunity to help promote the growth and shape the future of the Next-Gen SIEM and Log Management business at CrowdStrike.

You will combine your relevant technology sales experience with solid industry insight to successfully position our industry-leading NG SIEM and log management platform to our top Enterprise customers– articulating and demonstrating business value/ROI. Your job is to build out your territory and maximize market adoption.

In return, this position offers uncapped income potential in one of the most strategic, fastest-growing segments of the technology industry and an opportunity to join a company at the forefront of establishing de facto leadership in this market.

What You'll Do: Identify, develop, and execute account strategy to close new business opportunities and expanding revenue with customers across the assigned region; independently and cooperatively. Scope, negotiate, and bring to closure agreements to exceed booking and revenue quota targets.

Target and gain access to decision makers in key prospect accounts in the assigned territory. Establish access and maintain existing relationships with key decision makers (typically at the CIO and CSO level) in industry, partners, and enterprise customers to drive all pertinent issues related to sales strategy and goal attainment.

Collaborate with peers with cross-functional teams (including the Field Sales, Channels & Alliances, Marketing, Sales Operations, Sales Engineering, Services, Customer Support, and Product Management) to create visibility with target accounts and drive engagement of prospects at both the individual contributor and executive level.

Work cooperatively with partners to leverage their established account presence and relationships. Capture, maintain, and disseminate accurate and relevant prospect information using Salesforce.com.

What You’ll Need: 5+ years of high achievement selling enterprise platform solutions into one of the following markets (SIEM, log management, cybersecurity, observability, data analytics, or data management). Ability to adapt, thrive and excel in a fast-moving, nimble environment.

Strong presentation skills and ability to skillfully interact with technical stakeholders as well as executive decision makers. Success in owning and running the entire sales cycle from lead generation to close with a disciplined approach / methodology (MEDDPICC, MEDDIC, Challenger, Sandler, etc).

Comfortable in team selling environment working in close collaboration with peers in the CrowdStrike sales organization. History and reputable track record of exceeding goals and sales quotas – high achiever! Consultative sales approach – ability to challenge companies/businesses to think differently.

Strength in evangelizing technology and new account acquisition (hunting) – ability to discover and uncover new opportunities with prospects and existing business customers. Highly motivated and professional, with excellent verbal communication and interpersonal skills.

Outstanding organizational skills with the ability to prioritize and complete multiple tasks to meet deadlines. Self-starter able to work independently but also team oriented – work together, win together attitude. Excellent problem resolution skills – resourceful and constructive.

Benefits of Working at CrowdStrike: Market leader in compensation and equity awards Comprehensive physical and mental wellness programs Competitive vacation and holidays for recharge Paid parental and adoption leaves Professional development opportunities for all employees regardless of level or role Employee Networks, geographic neighborhood groups, and volunteer opportunities to build connections Vibrant office culture with world class amenities Great Place to Work Certified™ across the globe CrowdStrike is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

We are committed to fostering a culture of belonging where everyone is valued for who they are and empowered to succeed. We support veterans and individuals with disabilities through our affirmative action program. CrowdStrike is committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all employees and applicants for employment.

The Company does not discriminate in employment opportunities or practices on the basis of race, color, creed, ethnicity, religion, sex (including pregnancy or pregnancy-related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, marital or family status, veteran status, age, national origin, ancestry, physical disability (including HIV and AIDS), mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, membership or activity in a local human rights commission, status with regard to public assistance, or any other characteristic protected by law.

About Starbridge Starbridge helps go-to-market teams win in the public sector. Government buyers signal their priorities constantly, in council meetings, budget documents, RFPs, and public records, but that intelligence is scattered across thousands of sources and impossible to track by hand.

Our platform surfaces those signals, connects them to the right buyers, and turns them into pipeline. We move fast, stay close to our customers, and are building the category. This is a chance to join early and shape how we scale. About the Role At Starbridge , we're redefining how companies win public sector deals.

Our innovative GTM intelligence platform empowers businesses to confidently approach and win more contracts in the State, Local, and Education (SLED) market—a $1.5 trillion space ripe for disruption.

Leveraging AI-driven insights, we provide our clients with an unfair advantage in identifying early buying signals, streamlining outbound strategies, and automating cumbersome processes. We're hiring a Founding Business Development Representative to help drive our explosive early-stage growth.

This isn't a typical BDR job—it's an opportunity to join a fast-moving, high-impact team where your work directly contributes to the company's trajectory. In just our first three weeks, we booked 249 demos. You'll play a critical role in scaling this momentum. What You'll Do:
Lead Initial Outreach: Own the first touchpoint with prospects, leveraging our proprietary AI-powered insights to engage highly qualified leads through calls, emails, and LinkedIn.
Accelerate Pipeline Growth: Work closely with the sales team to convert conversations into demos, constantly optimizing messaging and outreach strategies.
Build from Scratch: As an early member, you'll influence the playbook for our outbound motion, shaping best practices that will scale as we grow.
Sales Bootcamp: You'll receive personalized mentorship, structured sales training, and clear pathways toward becoming an Account Executive on an accelerated timeline. We expect you to learn quickly and move into a closing role.

High Earning Potential: Uncapped commission structure directly tied to your performance, rewarding your hustle and effectiveness.
Rapid Advancement: Structured career growth designed to move you quickly into a higher-level sales role.
Perks & Support: Meaningful equity options and comprehensive onboarding & sales training.

Proven BDR experience: Ideally 1-2 years of experience in outbound sales or business development. If you have a different background but possess grit, intelligence, and ambition, we're flexible. Convince us why you're the perfect fit.
Relentless & Competitive: You thrive in competitive environments and approach challenges with resilience. The idea of spending 5 hours per day making dials fills you with excitement.
Coachable & Ambitious: You actively seek feedback, apply learnings quickly, and aspire to advance into an AE role.
Bachelor’s Degree Required: Field of study less important than your drive and results-oriented mindset.
If you're energized by the idea of shaping a rapidly growing startup and accelerating your sales career in a supportive, dynamic team, we want to talk to you. Interview Process We move fast — really fast. Getting back to someone today beats tomorrow, and our interview process reflects that mindset. Please keep us posted on your timeline so we can move quickly and speed things up where needed. All interviews are conducted via Google Meet. How We Work
Build Bridges to Help Customers Win - We pride ourselves on being obsessively customer-centric.
Shooting Star Speed - We move with extreme speed. We value momentum, decisiveness, and the ability to accelerate when it matters.
Fun Is a Feature - Fun is a Feature means we intentionally design Starbridge to be an energizing place to do hard work. Joy, humor, and camaraderie make great teams faster, sharper, and more resilient.
In the Arena - We believe the best ideas come from living close to the work, feeling the friction, hearing the nuance, and experiencing the details firsthand.

**Advance your career where Global Mobility drives strategic impact**
In **Global Employer Services**, we support internationally mobile employees and executives as they work across borders. Our work ensures that individuals sent on assignments abroad, relocating to Switzerland, or working across multiple countries remain fully compliant with tax and social security regulations-both locally and internationally.
As a Senior Tax Consultant, you will focus on **Swiss Individual Tax**, working within a high-impact team to deliver comprehensive, tailored solutions that address the complex needs of our global clients. You will be entrusted with increased ownership and responsibility, leading client engagements, mentoring junior colleagues, and contributing to the development of innovative tax strategies. Your expertise will be instrumental in shaping client success and driving the growth of our practice.

* You will have the opportunity to take ownership from **day one**, to be involved in client-facing activities in the field of Swiss tax.
* You will be the **primary driver of a client engagement team**, steering tax compliance delivery, managing engagement finances, and providing regular outcome and risk reports to the manager to ensure client-centric and efficient execution. You will also integrate, mentor and **develop junior team members**.
* You will lead and manage Swiss and international tax compliance projects, including review of Swiss **tax declarations** and analyze complex international tax and social security positions.
* You will review **advice** tailored to each client, supported by thorough research and up-to-date knowledge of Swiss and international tax laws.
* You will further develop specific **knowledge** in Swiss national and international tax. Combine your strengths with the know-how of our experienced teams to unlock your full professional and personal potential, supporting clients across a broad spectrum of tax and social security topics.
* You will have the opportunity to apply your technical knowledge to challenging cases and assist in delivering **presentations** to clients and colleagues.
* You will lead **complex tax consulting briefings** with clients on intricate cross-border assignments, providing clear, practical advice on Swiss tax and social-security implications. You will build and maintain client relationships as the primary point of contact, coordinate with international teams on multi-jurisdictional matters.

* Strong technical knowledge of Swiss national tax laws and international tax principles, including social security regulations related to cross-border mobility.
* Curiosity, proactive mindset with a willingness to take ownership and drive projects forward independently.
* Excellent teamwork and communication skills-both written and verbal-with the ability to explain complex tax matters clearly to clients and colleagues.
* Great analytical and problem-solving skills, with a keen attention to detail.
* Proficiency in MS Office applications and familiarity with tax software and digital tools.
* Ability to work effectively in a team-oriented, multicultural environment and fast-paced environment
**Your profile**
* Bachelor-s or master-s degree in law, business, economics, finance or similar
* 3-5 years' experience in individual taxation (German: Natürliche Personen) and social security law, gained in a trust/fiduciary practice, tax authority, social security administration or consulting firm.
* Preferred experience (non-mandatory): Experience in global mobility, expatriate or international tax advisory, including cross-border work for multinational clients.
* Commitment to continuous learning and professional development.
* Fluent in German and English
* MS Office proficiency

Teamwork and cross-disciplinary collaboration across all business lines are at the heart of what we do.

**Help organisations stay one step ahead of cyber threats **
Cyber attacks are no longer a question of if, but when. While prevention remains important, organisations increasingly rely on their ability to detect threats early, respond effectively, and recover quickly.
At Deloitte, we help some of Switzerland's largest and most critical organisations build and transform their cyber defence capabilities. From designing Cyber Defence Centres and Security Operations Centres to improving incident response, deploying security technologies, and exploring AI-enabled security operations, we help our clients strengthen their resilience against an ever-evolving threat landscape.
If you are passionate about cyber defence, enjoy solving complex challenges, and want to work at the intersection of strategy, operations, and technology, this is the opportunity for you.
**How you can make an impact **
As a Cyber Detect & Respond Advisor, you will work alongside experienced cyber professionals to help clients prepare for, detect, respond to, and recover from cyber threats and attacks.

* Assess and improve cyber defence capabilities, including Security Operations Centres (SOC), Cyber Defence Centres (CDC), Incident Response, Threat Intelligence, Threat Hunting, and Vulnerability Management
* Help clients design practical and effective cyber defence strategies, operating models, governance structures, and transformation roadmaps
* Design, implement, configure, and optimise cyber defence technologies such as SIEM, EDR, NDR, Threat Intelligence, and Vulnerability Management platforms
* Support the development of detection use cases, monitoring capabilities, automation workflows, and security operations processes
* Conduct cyber defence assessments, maturity reviews, and benchmarking exercises to identify improvement opportunities
* Support incident response readiness activities, including playbook development, tabletop exercises, and crisis preparedness initiatives
* Evaluate emerging technologies and help clients understand how innovations such as AI-powered security operations can enhance detection and response capabilities
* Work closely with specialists across Deloitte to deliver integrated cyber security solutions that create measurable value for clients
* Contribute to business development, thought leadership, and the continued growth of Deloitte's Detect & Respond practice

We are looking for curious and motivated professionals who combine technical expertise with a desire to make a real impact. You bring:
* Approximately 5+ years of professional experience in cyber security, cyber defence, security operations, incident response, threat intelligence, cyber engineering, or a related field

* Familiarity with technologies such as Microsoft Sentinel, Splunk, XSIAM, CrowdStrike, Microsoft Defender, SentinelOne, Cortex XDR, EDR, NDR, SIEM, or similar solutions

* University degree in a relevant field (Bachelor's or Master's)
* Fluent English; German and/or French are an advantage
**Your team**
You will join a diverse, international, and highly collaborative team of cyber security professionals who are passionate about helping organisations strengthen their resilience against cyber threats.
What makes our team different is the opportunity to work across the full cyber defence lifecycle. We believe that great careers are built through challenging work, continuous learning, and strong support. You will benefit from hands-on experience, dedicated mentoring, professional certifications, and collaboration with experts across Deloitte's global network.
Most importantly, we foster an open and inclusive culture where people are encouraged to bring new ideas, challenge the status quo, and shape the future of cyber defence.

Pipeline Hygiene: Log activity, disposition, and source data accurately in HubSpot and Salesforce (Legacy and Greenpath), giving leadership reliable visibility into pipeline health.
Performance & Coaching: Hit weekly and monthly activity and meetings-booked targets, and show up for regular 1:1 coaching and Gong call reviews to keep sharpening your messaging and objection handling.
Market Intelligence: Share what you're hearing in the field — competitive signals, regional trends, buying triggers — so the team can keep refining how we target and message.

Organizational skills to manage a high volume of accounts and outreach without losing attention to detail.

About AirOps
AirOps is the full-service platform for brand growth in the age of AI search. As consumers shift from traditional search engines to platforms like ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini, the entire ruleset of growth is being rewritten. Buyers now rely on agents to discover, recommend, and purchase products and services for them. If your brand isn't part of the answer, you aren't in the running.
Our platform offers everything a brand needs to get found, recommended, and earn trust. We work with category leaders, including teams at Ramp, Chime, Airbnb, ServiceNow, and Rippling, to drive visibility and accelerate growth from AI search.
Backed by Greylock, Unusual Ventures, Wing VC, and Founder Collective, we're headquartered in San Francisco, New York, and Montevideo.

AirOps is opening its first dedicated EMEA sales development role at a moment when AI-driven content discovery is reshaping how European brands compete. You will own the full outbound motion across EMEA, prospecting into marketing and growth teams in the UK, DACH, Nordics, Benelux, France, Southern Europe, and beyond. This is not a UK-only seat.
You will build pipeline across multiple markets, navigating different buying cultures and business contexts every day. You'll work cross-functionally with Sales and GTM Engineering to turn intent signals into qualified discovery calls that map prospect pain to our AI capabilities.

Based hybrid out of our central London office, you are the first face of AirOps for EMEA buyers. The role reports into our Sales leadership and carries a direct line to how quickly we scale internationally. If you want a front-row seat to building a region from scratch, this is it.

Build the Engine: As one of the founding EMEA SDRs, you'll develop and execute creative outreach strategies that don't just hit targets, they crush them. You'll be the one finding the "needles in the haystack" and turning them into qualified pipeline.
Be an AI Matchmaker: Conduct discovery calls that act as deep-dive consultations. Your goal is to map prospect pain points to our AI capabilities, not just read a script.
Own the First Impression: You are the first face of AirOps. You’ll build authentic, high-trust relationships with key decision-makers before they even realize they need a better workflow.
Pass the Torch: Work in lockstep with our Account Executives to ensure that every handoff is seamless, qualified, and set up for a closed-won win.
The "Data Artist": Keep our CRM (our "Source of Truth") clean, organized, and actionable. We value data-driven iteration—if an email template isn't working, iterate, A/B test, and optimize until it does.
Startup Speed: In a high-growth environment, agility is your superpower. Whether you're troubleshooting a new outreach tool or jumping on a last-minute demo, you thrive on the "all-hands-on-deck" pace.

The "Hungry" Factor: 0-1 years of B2B SaaS sales experience. If you’ve got the grit, we’ll provide the roadmap. Bonus points if you’ve spent time in the marketing or growth-tech trenches.
Outreach Ninja: Whether it's a cold call, a hyper-personalized email, or a strategic LinkedIn connection, you know how to cut through the noise without sounding like a bot.
High EQ & Active Listening: You know that discovery is 80% listening and 20% speaking. You have the empathy to understand a prospect's frustrations and the communication skills to offer the solution.
Bias for Action: You are just as comfortable running solo on a new project as you are jumping into a team brainstorming session. You own your outcomes.
A Track Record of "Done": Whether it’s a side project, a degree, or a previous job, you have a history of starting things and actually finishing them.
The Vibe-Coder Mindset: We build with AI, and we want you to understand it. Experience coding, scripting, or playing around with "vibe-coding" platforms (Claude Code, Cursor, Lovable, etc.) is a massive plus. You don't need to be a software engineer, but you've ideally gone beyond simply using LLMs as research and content-generation tools.
Nice to have: Fluent in a European language beyond English. German, French, Spanish, Dutch, or a Nordic language would open doors across key EMEA markets.

Region Zentralschweiz | Volmera GmbH / EET-Schweiz
Deine Rolle
Als Aussendienstmitarbeiter/in bei der Volmera GmbH bist du täglich in deiner Verkaufsregion unterwegs und vertrittst moderne Energielösungen direkt beim Kunden.
Du begleitest den gesamten Verkaufsprozess – vom ersten persönlichen Kontakt über die Beratung bis hin zum erfolgreichen Vertragsabschluss. Dabei arbeitest du selbstständig, übernimmst Verantwortung für deine Ergebnisse und wirst gleichzeitig durch klare Prozesse, regelmässige Schulungen und ein engagiertes Team unterstützt.
Bei uns zählt nicht nur Verkaufserfahrung. Entscheidend sind deine Einstellung, deine Lernbereitschaft, dein Auftreten und dein Wille, dich weiterzuentwickeln.
Deine Aufgaben

* Aktive Neukundenakquise im Aussendienst
* Persönliche Ansprache von Hauseigentümerinnen und Hauseigentümern
* Vereinbarung von qualifizierten Beratungsterminen
* Durchführung persönlicher Verkaufsgespräche beim Kunden
* Analyse der individuellen Kundensituation und des Energiebedarfs
* Beratung rund um moderne Solar- und Energielösungen
* Verständliche Präsentation unserer Produkte und deren Vorteile
* Erstellung einer passenden Lösung für den jeweiligen Kunden
* Aktive Führung des Verkaufsgesprächs bis zum Vertragsabschluss
* Professioneller Umgang mit Fragen und Einwänden
* Betreuung der Kunden vom Erstkontakt bis zum erfolgreichen Abschluss
* Saubere Dokumentation und Pflege der Kundenkontakte
* Teilnahme an internen Schulungen, Verkaufstrainings und Teamsitzungen
* Kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung der eigenen Verkaufs- und Kommunikationsfähigkeiten
Was wir von dir erwarten
Du musst bei uns kein fertiger Verkaufsprofi sein. Wir suchen Menschen, die bereit sind, Verantwortung für ihre eigene Entwicklung und ihre Leistung zu übernehmen.

* Freude am persönlichen Kontakt mit Menschen
* Selbstbewusstes und gepflegtes Auftreten
* Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse
* Kommunikationsstärke und Überzeugungskraft
* Eigeninitiative und selbstständige Arbeitsweise
* Disziplin, Zuverlässigkeit und Durchhaltevermögen
* Bereitschaft, Feedback anzunehmen und umzusetzen
* Lernbereitschaft und Interesse an persönlicher Weiterentwicklung
* Leistungs- und Zielorientierung
* Bereitschaft, aktiv auf neue Menschen zuzugehen
* Führerausweis Kategorie B
* Eigenes Fahrzeug
Quereinsteigerinnen und Quereinsteiger sind ausdrücklich willkommen.
Erfahrung im Verkauf oder Aussendienst ist von Vorteil, aber keine Voraussetzung. Viel wichtiger ist für uns, dass du bereit bist, zu lernen und Leistung zu bringen.
Was dich bei uns erwartet
Bei der Volmera GmbH erhältst du nicht einfach einen Arbeitsplatz. Du bekommst die Möglichkeit, dir im Verkauf etwas aufzubauen und dich fachlich wie persönlich weiterzuentwickeln.

* Fixlohn von CHF 3’500.– zuzüglich attraktiver leistungsabhängiger Vergütung
* Überdurchschnittliche Verdienstmöglichkeiten bei entsprechender Leistung
* 6 Wochen Ferien
* Strukturierte Einführung und Einarbeitung
* Regelmässige Verkaufsschulungen und Trainings
* Klare Verkaufsprozesse und Leitfäden
* Persönliche Begleitung während deiner Entwicklung
* Selbstständiges Arbeiten
* Direkten Kundenkontakt und abwechslungsreiche Arbeitstage
* Ein leistungsorientiertes Umfeld mit klaren Zielen
* Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten innerhalb des Unternehmens
* Perspektiven für Mitarbeitende, die langfristig zusätzliche Verantwortung übernehmen möchten
Unser Arbeitsalltag
Unser Aussendienst lebt von persönlichem Kundenkontakt. Deshalb verbringen unsere Mitarbeitenden einen grossen Teil ihrer Arbeitszeit direkt in ihrer Verkaufsregion.
Der Arbeitsalltag besteht aus der aktiven Kundengewinnung, der Terminierung sowie den anschliessenden Beratungsgesprächen beim Kunden.
Zusätzlich finden regelmässige interne Schulungen und Verkaufstrainings statt. Dadurch sollst du nicht nur unsere Produkte kennen, sondern lernen, Kundensituationen richtig einzuschätzen, Gespräche professionell zu führen und dich kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln.
Wen wir suchen
Wir suchen keine Person, die einfach nur irgendeinen Job möchte.
Wir suchen Menschen, die etwas erreichen wollen.
Menschen, die bereit sind, auf andere zuzugehen, Neues zu lernen, an sich zu arbeiten und auch dann dranzubleiben, wenn nicht jeder Tag gleich erfolgreich läuft.
Du solltest Freude daran haben, deine eigenen Ergebnisse aktiv beeinflussen zu können. Wer Verantwortung übernimmt, konsequent an sich arbeitet und Leistung zeigt, soll bei uns auch die Möglichkeit erhalten, entsprechend weiterzukommen.
Über uns
Die Volmera GmbH ist als Franchisepartner von EET-Schweiz im Bereich moderner Energielösungen tätig.
Unser Fokus liegt auf der persönlichen Beratung von Hauseigentümerinnen und Hauseigentümern und auf Lösungen, mit denen erneuerbare Energie einfach und sinnvoll in den Alltag integriert werden kann.
Wir möchten nicht nur unseren Kunden einen Mehrwert bieten, sondern gleichzeitig ein Verkaufsteam aufbauen, in dem Entwicklung, Eigenverantwortung, Leistung und gegenseitige Unterstützung einen hohen Stellenwert haben.
Dein nächster Schritt
Du erkennst dich in dieser Beschreibung wieder und möchtest herausfinden, ob der Aussendienst zu dir passt?
Dann freuen wir uns auf deine vollständigen Bewerbungsunterlagen.
Nach einer ersten Prüfung deiner Bewerbung lernen wir uns in einem persönlichen Gespräch kennen. Im weiteren Bewerbungsprozess erhältst du die Möglichkeit, unseren Arbeitsalltag und den Aussendienst näher kennenzulernen.
Volmera GmbH / EET-Schweiz
Gemeinsam für moderne Energielösungen – und für Menschen, die etwas bewegen wollen.

Als führender Anbieter setzen wir auf nachhaltige Infrastrukturlösungen für eine sichere, effiziente und zukunftsfähige Grundversorgung.
Du behältst den Überblick, packst gerne selbst mit an und bringst Projekte zuverlässig ins Ziel? Dann suchen wir genau dich! Als unser neues Talent in der
**Projektsachbearbeitung Innendienst 100%**
übernimmst du Verantwortung, denkst mit und sorgst dafür, dass bei uns von der ersten Anfrage bis zur erfolgreichen Auslieferung alles rundläuft.
Das ist dein Tag bei uns: Du startest flexibel zwischen und Uhr mit einem Kaffee in unserem schönen Büro in der Nähe des Zürichsees.

Du koordinierst eigenverantwortlich und zuverlässig die gesamte Auftrags\- und Projektabwicklung (von der Auftragserfassung über Beschaffung und Terminverfolgung bis hin zur Auslieferung), analysierst die Kundenanforderungen und arbeitest massgeschneiderte Angebote aus, bist Ansprechperson für unsere Kunden, Lieferanten und Aussendienst\-Mitarbeiter, managest den Einkauf und das Lager und pflegst unsere Stammdaten.

* Du hast eine abgeschlossene kaufmännische oder technische Grundausbildung. Falls du eine technische Grundausbildung hast, solltest du zusätzlich eine kaufmännische oder betriebswirtschaftliche Weiterbildung mitbringen
* Du hast mehrjährige Erfahrung im Verkaufsinnendienst, insbesondere in der Projektsachbearbeitung
* Du bringst ein ausgeprägtes technisches Verständnis sowie Interesse an technischen Produkten und deren Spezifikationen mit
* Du hast bereits Erfahrung im Einkauf gesammelt
* Du gehst sicherer mit ERP\-Systemen um
* Dir gefällt die selbstständige, strukturierte und gewissenhafte Arbeitsweise
* Du bist kommunikationsstark, belastbar und hast eine ausgeprägte Team\- und Sozialkompetenz
* Du sprichst und schreibst fliessend Deutsch
**Was dich zu den top Bewerbenden macht:**
* Deine Erfahrung mit ERP ABACUS
* Deine guten Sprachkenntnisse in Französisch und Italienisch

# Mitarbeiter Verkaufssupport (w/m/d) Generalagentur Kreuzlingen #
**Versicherung Generalagentur / Kreuzlingen** **/ Berufserfahrene** **/ Unbefristet/ 60% - 100%**
## Das erwartet dich ##
Bei uns steht der Mensch im Mittelpunkt und Teamarbeit wird grossgeschrieben. Du bist mit Herz und Begeisterung bei der Arbeit und schätzt den offenen Austausch im Team. In dieser Rolle arbeitest Du eng mit unseren Versicherungs- und Vorsorgeberatern zusammen und trägst zu einem positiven Kundenerlebnis und zur Zufriedenheit unserer Kundinnen und Kunden bei.
## Das bewirkst du bei uns ##
In dieser Funktion koordinierst und unterstützt Du die Versicherungs- und Vorsorgeberatenden in allen Verkaufsprozessen. Du übernimmst in dieser dienstleistungs- und vertriebsorientierten Zusammenarbeit eine aktive Rolle und stellst eine optimale Betreuung und Beratung unserer Kundinnen und Kunden sicher.
Zudem bist Du mitverantwortlich für die partnerschaftliche Zusammenarbeit mit unseren professionellen Maklern und Vermittlern.
Mit Organisationsgeschick und hohem Bewusstsein für Servicequalität erstellst Du selbstständig Offerten, verarbeitest Anträge, vereinbarst Termine und bist Teil der administrativen Drehscheibe der Generalagentur Kreuzlingen. Du übernimmst die Beratung und Betreuung der Kundinnen und Kunden am Empfang und am Telefon und hilfst mit bei der Ausbildung der Lernenden.
## Das bringst du mit ##
* Abgeschlossene Ausbildung im kaufmännischen Bereich
* Berufserfahrung in der Versicherungsbranche
* Freude am direktem Kundenkontakt sowie an enger Zusammenarbeit im Team
* Eigenständige sowie pragmatische Arbeitsweise
* Offene, empathische und loyale Persönlichkeit
* Fliessende Deutschkenntnisse
## Bei uns arbeiten ##
Ein junges und dynamisches Team wartet auf Dich. Zusammen prägen wir die regionale Verankerung und pflegen einen offenen, kollegialen Austausch. Gemeinsam schaffen wir Vertrauen in die Mobiliar als persönlichste Versicherung der Schweiz.
Wir bieten eine vielseitige und abwechslungsreiche Tätigkeit in einem motivierten und ambitionierten Team. Dich erwarten ein modernes Arbeitsumfeld, ausgezeichnete Arbeitsbedingungen sowie umfassende Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten. Du profitierst von einer sorgfältigen Einarbeitungsphase und einer abwechslungsreichen Tätigkeit in einem spannenden Umfeld mit Entwicklungspotential.
Dein Arbeitsort ist Kreuzlingen und das Arbeitspensum beträgt 60% - 100%. Stellentritt per sofort oder nach Vereinbarung.
## Das bieten wir ##
##### Erfolgsbeteiligung #####
Sind wir erfolgreich, profitieren auch unsere Mitarbeitenden. Jedes Jahr wird über die Ausschüttung einer Erfolgsbeteiligung und deren Höhe entschieden.
##### Weiterbildung und Entwicklung #####
Wir bieten ein vielfältiges internes Kursangebot an. Bei jobrelevanten Weiterbildungen beteiligen wir uns.
##### Vergünstigungen #####
Wir bieten unter anderem bis zu 25% Prämienrabatt, Rabatte auf Mobiltelefone sowie kostenlose Abonnemente mit Flatrate und Ermässigungen bei kulturellen Veranstaltungen.
## Neugierig? ##
Bewerben Sie sich rasch und unkompliziert per E-Mail, oder ruf einfach an. Wir freuen uns auf dich!

Leiter Verkaufssupport

##### Berufe #####
Du suchst ein spannendes Arbeitsumfeld, wo du dein Wissen und deine Persönlichkeit einbringen kannst? Wir suchen Mitarbeitende und Führungskräfte, die zu unseren Werten passen und etwas bewirken wollen.

Die rund 80 Generalagenturen der Mobiliar mit über 160 Standorten bieten vielfältige Jobs und attraktive Karrieremöglichkeiten.
